topic: Food Truck Out of Cash Change

script.title: FOOD TRUCK TAB
script.scene_zh: 餐車窗口 · 付款卡關
script.story_hook: The card reader dies at the food truck.
script.intro_zh: 餐車的讀卡機，剛好在這時候當機。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a food truck has no change. Listen for problem-solving ideas.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天餐車找不開錢。留意想辦法解決的說法。
script.outro: Tacos gone, trust kept. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 塔可吃進肚，信任留下來。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each payment phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀付款情境的說法。
script.char_a_description: a tall man in his twenties with short cornrow braids, wearing a red basketball jersey, denim shorts and slide sandals, athletic build, holding a phone and a set of keys
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman with curly brown hair under a printed bandana, wearing a stained apron reading TACOS over a rolled-sleeve shirt, clogs and an eager smile, stocky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two al pastor tacos and one elote, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu æl ˈpɑstɚ ˈtɑkoʊz ænd wʌn eɪˈloʊteɪ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 兩份烤肉塔可，加一根烤玉米，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You got it. That'll be twelve fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɑt ɪt ðæz bɪ twɛlv ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，一共十二塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card real quick?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑɹd ɹiəl kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我刷卡付一下，很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uh, the reader's been dead all morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ðə ˈɹidɚz bɪn dɛd ɑl ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 呃……讀卡機從早壞到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Wi-Fi down, or the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈwaɪfaɪ daʊn ɔɹ ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 噢不。是沒網路，還是機器壞了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine. A new one comes Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ə nu wʌn kʌmz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 機器的問題，新的週五到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… I only have a twenty here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv ə ˈtwɛnti hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧……我身上只有二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A twenty? I'm fresh out of change, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtwɛnti aɪm fɹɛʃ aʊt ʌv tʃeɪndʒ fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 二十塊？零錢剛好全用完了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just opened, right? I saw the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd ɹaɪt aɪ sɔ ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛才開張對吧？我看到排隊的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just opened! And that line took every coin.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd ænd ðæt laɪn tʊk ˈɛvɹi kɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 才剛開張，那排隊伍就把銅板全掃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we're stuck. That's awkward, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪɹ stʌk ðæts ˈɔɹkwəd hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們卡住了。這有點尷尬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's an ATM two blocks up, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz æn ˌeɪ ti ˈɛm tu blɑks ʌp ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 前頭兩個街口有提款機，應該。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe? I hate maybe when I'm hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪ heɪt ˈmeɪbi wɛn aɪm ˈhʌŋɡɹi/
dialogue.zh: 說「應該」？我肚子餓時最怕這種話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Fair. Corner store, next to the gym.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ ˈkɔɹnɚ stɔɹ nɛkst tə ðə dʒɪm/
dialogue.zh: 哈！也對。角頭超商，就在健身房隔壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll run. Will you still be here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪl ɹʌn wɪl ju stɪl bi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。我跑一趟，你還在這裡吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until three. We'll keep your order warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl θɹi wil kip jʊɹ ˈɔɹdɚ wɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 賣到三點，你的餐我會保溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Back in five, tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt bæk ɪn faɪv tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。五分鐘內回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait — what's your name, for the plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌts jʊɹ neɪm fɔɹ ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等——你叫什麼？標在餐盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: DeShawn. D-e-S-H-a-w-n. Tough, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈʃɑn di ˈi ˈɛs eɪtʃ ˈeɪ ˈdʌbl̩ju ˈɛn tɔf ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: DeShawn。D-e-S-H-a-w-n，難拼吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: DeShawn, noted. Two tacos, one elote.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈʃɑn ˈnoʊtɪd tu ˈtɑkoʊz wʌn eɪˈloʊteɪ/
dialogue.zh: DeShawn，記好了。兩份塔可、一根烤玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm back! And guess what — it ate my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm bæk ænd ɡɛs wʌt ɪt eɪt maɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 我回來了！你猜怎麼了——機器吞了我的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No! The ATM kept your card? Oh man.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði ˌeɪ ti ˈɛm kɛpt jʊɹ kɑɹd oʊ mæn/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧！提款機吃掉你的卡？天啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screen said 'out of order', then game over.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɹin sɛd aʊt ʌv ˈɔɹdɚ ðɛn ɡeɪm ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕顯示「故障」，然後就完蛋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That machine has been mean since spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt məˈʃin hæz bɪn min sɪns spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那台機器從春天起就很不乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My money is fine, but now I have no cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌni ɪz faɪn bʌt naʊ aɪ hæv noʊ kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 錢還在卡裡，但我現在沒現錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the tacos are still a problem, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈtɑkoʊz ɑɹ stɪl ə ˈpɹɑbləm hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 所以這頓塔可還是卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep. Hungry, broke, and no card. New combo.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈhʌŋɡɹi bɹoʊk ænd noʊ kɑɹd nu ˈkɑmˌboʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對啊。又餓又沒錢還沒卡，新組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen. How about we do the trust thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsn haʊ əˈbaʊt wi du ðə tɹʌst θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 聽著，我們來玩「信任那一招」怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trust thing? I like how that sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɹʌst θɪŋ aɪ laɪk haʊ ðæt saʊndz/
dialogue.zh: 信任那一招？聽起來挺有意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the plate now. Pay Tuesday. Simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə pleɪt naʊ peɪ ˈtuzdeɪ ˈsɪmpəl̩/
dialogue.zh: 餐你先拿，星期二再付，很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday? I'm off Tuesdays, so yes!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ aɪm ɑf ˈtuzdeɪz soʊ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 星期二？我週二排休，成交！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write your name on my chalkboard tab.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt jʊɹ neɪm ɑn maɪ ˈtʃɔkˌbɔɹd tæb/
dialogue.zh: 我會把你的名字寫在粉筆記帳板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A chalkboard tab? That's old-school. Cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtʃɔkˌbɔɹd tæb ðæts ˌoʊld ˈskul kul/
dialogue.zh: 粉筆記帳板？好復古，太酷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen years, and that board never fails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin jɪɹz ænd ðæt bɔɹd ˈnɛvɚ feɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 十五年了，那塊板子從沒出過錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody ever ran off on your tab?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbəˌdi ˈɛvɚ ɹæn ɑf ɑn jʊɹ tæb/
dialogue.zh: 都沒有人吃完就跑帳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once. He came back with two cakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns hi keɪm bæk wɪθ tu keɪks/
dialogue.zh: 只有一次。他回頭送了兩個蛋糕來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With cakes? Now I feel bad for doubting.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð keɪks naʊ aɪ fil bæd fɔɹ ˈdaʊbɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還帶蛋糕？那我更不好意思懷疑你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha. Go eat. The salsa's on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡoʊ it ðə ˈsɑlsəz ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈。先去吃，莎莎醬在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a legend, did you know that?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə ˈlɛdʒənd dɪd ju noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你根本是傳奇，你自己知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm a taco dealer, mostly. Here, napkins.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ə ˈtɑkoʊ dɪlɚ ˈmoʊstli hɪɹ ˈnæpkɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 我主要就是賣塔可的。給，餐巾紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I send the money by app instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɛnd ðə ˈmʌni baɪ æp ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 到時候我直接用App轉帳給你可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure can. My number's on the window sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ kæn maɪ ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈstɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。我的號碼在窗貼上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me so I get the name right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi soʊ aɪ ɡɛt ðə neɪm ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你傳訊息給我，我才不會按錯名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll text the truck name and the amount.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛkst ðə tɹʌk neɪm ænd ði əˈmaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我會傳車名和金額給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh — is water free here?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn oʊ ɪz ˈwɔɾɚ fɹi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。對了——這裡的水免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water is always free, no tab needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔɾɚ ɪz ˈɔlweɪz fɹi noʊ tæb ˈnidɪd/
dialogue.zh: 水永遠免費，不用掛帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a cup for the road, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə kʌp fɔɹ ðə ɹod pliz/
dialogue.zh: 那請給我一杯路上喝的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cup, ice, extra lime. Still free, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp aɪs ˈɛkstɚ laɪm stɪl fɹi ɹɪˈlæks/
dialogue.zh: 一杯、加冰、多一片萊姆，還是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people deserve a line all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈpipəl̩ dɪˈzɜɹv ə laɪn ɑl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你們這種店家，值得整天排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We just have good salsa and patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dʒʌst hæv ɡʊd ˈsɑlsə ænd ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 我們靠的是好莎莎醬，還有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday then. Twelve fifty on the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ ðɛn twɛlv ˈfɪfti ɑn ði æp/
dialogue.zh: 那就週二，用App轉十二塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring nothing — the app handles it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ˈnʌθɪŋ ði æp ˈhændəlz ɪt ɑl/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不用帶，App會搞定一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the truck called, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə tɹʌk kɔld baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你們餐車叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolling Salsa! You can search that name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹoʊlɪŋ ˈsɑlsə ju kæn sɜɹtʃ ðæt neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 「滾動莎莎」！搜這個名字就找得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave five stars, with today's story.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl liːv faɪv stɑɹz wɪθ təˈdeɪz ˈstɔɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我要留五顆星，附上今天的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them the chalkboard is brave and true.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm ðə ˈtʃɔkˌbɔɹd ɪz bɹeɪv ænd tɹu/
dialogue.zh: 記得誇誇我那塊勇敢又誠實的板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Your tacos beat my packed lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl jʊɹ ˈtɑkoʊz bit maɪ pækt lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 一定會。你的塔可完勝我的便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Packed lunch tastes like sadness, anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pækt lʌntʃ teɪsts laɪk ˈsædnəs ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！便當吃起來，永遠像難過的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Truth. See you Tuesday, legend. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹuθ siː ju ˈtuzdeɪ ˈlɛdʒənd baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大實話。週二見，傳奇大姐，拜拜！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, DeShawn! The board says you're hungry already.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ dɪˈʃɑn ðə bɔɹd sɛz jʊɹ ˈhʌŋɡɹi ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜，DeShawn！板子都說你又餓了。

script.youtube_title_en: "How About We Do the Trust Thing" — Food Truck Out of Cash Change
script.youtube_description:
60句餐車付款聽力練習：刷卡機當機、攤主找不開錢、提款機又吞卡，一頓塔可吃變成一場信任測試，該怎麼收場？

這一集跟著飢腸轆轆的常客，從點餐到付款一路碰壁：讀卡機死機、排隊人潮掃光零錢、隔壁街提款機吃掉銀行卡。最後靠一塊用了十五年的粉筆記帳板，換來「先吃再說、週二付款」的暖心方案。

你會聽到：
- 點餐與報價：「That'll be twelve fifty.」
- 付款出狀況的說法：「The reader's been dead all morning.」
- 想辦法的提案句：「How about we do the trust thing?」
- 轉帳、掛帳與回饋評價的自然對話

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of food-truck listening practice: a hungry customer has only a twenty, the truck is fresh out of change, the card reader is dead, and the corner ATM eats the debit card on top of it.

You will hear how to order from a truck, describe payment problems, take suggestions, and end up with a chalkboard tab and a promise to pay by app next Tuesday. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
肚子餓到不行，刷卡機卻偏偏當機，怎麼辦？
身上只有大鈔、攤主找不開錢，這一餐還能吃嗎？

這一集帶大家走到餐車窗口前，跟著一位常客度過連環付款風波：讀卡機死機、提款機吞卡，最後竟靠一塊老粉筆記帳板，換得一餐和一份信任。

你會聽到：
🌮 點餐報價：「That'll be twelve fifty.」
💳 付款狀況：「The reader's been dead all morning.」
🧾 暖心提案：「Take the plate now. Pay Tuesday. Simple.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。

script.thumbnail_action: holding up a twenty dollar bill
